title: Geometric pullback of integral reduction and its normalized endpoints
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$ on which $\ell$ is invertible, and $f:X\to Y$. Use normalized Chern data $c_Y,c_X$ [def-sp-tower-class-chern] and any intermediate integral-coefficient pullback $d=(P_R,\beta,e_0,e_1,k)$ [def-sp-tower-chern-pullback-intermediate]. Write $L_T$ for the recorded derived integral reduction to $R_T$-systems, $F$ for derived abelian inverse image, $z:F\mathbf Z_Y\to\mathbf Z_X$ and $a:FG_Y[1]\to G_X[1]$ for the canonical maps [lem-sp-tower-integral-class-pullback], $s_T:L_T\mathbf Z_T\simeq R_T$ for the normalized unit, and $r_T:L_TG_T[1]\simeq M_T[2]$ for the normalized positive Kummer root identification. There exists a natural transformation $\rho:L_YP_R^D\to FL_X$ such that $\rho_{\mathbf Z_Y}L_X(z)s_X=P_R^D(s_Y)e_0^D$ and $\rho_{G_Y[1]}L_X(a)r_X=P_R^D(r_Y)e_1^D(2)$. Compositions are left to right. Only integral reduction is compared; scalar extension to $A_T$ and Tate tensor lines are absent.

lean.statement:
theorem tower_chernReduction_pullback
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (_hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤))) (_hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (cY : Chern l E Y) (cX : Chern l E X)
    (_nY : cY.Normalized l E) (_nX : cX.Normalized l E)
    (d : IntegralCoefficientPullback l E f cY cX) :
    ∃ η : cY.reduction.derived ⋙ d.pull.mapDerivedCategory ⟶
        (abPull f).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ cX.reduction.derived,
      η.app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab Y) 0).obj (integers Y)) ≫
          cX.reduction.derived.map (integerDerivedPull f) ≫ cX.unitIso.hom =
        d.pull.mapDerivedCategory.map cY.unitIso.hom ≫ d.derivedUnit.hom ∧
      η.app (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab Y) 0).obj (units Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≫
          cX.reduction.derived.map (unitsDerivedPull f) ≫ cX.rootIso.hom =
        d.pull.mapDerivedCategory.map cY.rootIso.hom ≫ (d.derivedRoot 2).hom
